name: USDB Blast
oneLiner: USDB is Blast L2's native yield-bearing dollar, bridged USDC/USDT routed through MakerDAO DSR with auto-rebasing yield to Blast holders.
collateral: DAI held through Blast's MakerDAO DSR yield manager; USDC, USDT, and DAI are supported bridge deposit inputs, while USDB withdrawals redeem to DAI.
pegMechanism: Automatic rebasing with yield from underlying centralized stablecoin strategies

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: D18 requires the tracked holder claim and current backing mechanism to determine the archetype. USDB holders receive an auto-rebasing Blast token redeemable to DAI through the Ethereum bridge; at Ethereum block 26097122 the yield manager TOKEN() was DAI and getProviderInfoAt(0) identified its DSR provider. This establishes a bridged protocol-position claim, not direct BRL/USD cash reserves, a Treasury fund share, or borrower CDP issuance by USDB holders. No existing family has a fully evidenced exact-product mapping, so the previous fiat-cash resolution is withdrawn rather than replacing it with the parent's CDP or a marketed T-Bill category. DAI backing and dependency evidence remain intact; approved bridge inputs do not establish FRAX/frxUSD backing. Re-review when Blast publishes enforceable holder-claim terms and a complete current strategy inventory, or when the methodology owner admits an evidenced bridge/yield-claim family.

sources.label: Blast USDB rebasing and DAI redemption documentation
